SIGN_AND_TARGET_AUDIT.coordinate_under_test: obs35[4] = pros_ankle_angle, the PROSTHETIC ankle joint angle; obs35[2] = pros_knee_angle. Bounds knee (-1.5, 0), ankle (-0.7, +0.7) rad. In this convention NEGATIVE ankle = plantarflexion (push-off), POSITIVE = dorsiflexion

two_distinct_references_were_in_play.training_target: u_IK AB06 prosthetic-side action, decoded per PROTOCOL_F2R sec.3 as q_ankle = 0.7*a, q_knee = 0.75*a - 0.75. Measured on the 500 nominal rows: q_ankle_IK min -0.15516, max +0.40018, 19.4% of rows NEGATIVE (73 of the 380 training rows, 19.2%)
two_distinct_references_were_in_play.reporting_reference: cache targets[:,2], the HEALTHY CONTRALATERAL ankle. Measured: min +0.08647, max +0.44138, mean +0.23356, frac_negative 0.000 - it NEVER goes negative
two_distinct_references_were_in_play.distance_between_them: RMSE(q_ankle_IK, healthy_ankle) = 0.13480 on the ankle and 0.09596 on the knee: they are different signals, not two views of one target

SIGN_AND_TARGET_AUDIT.why_sign_agreement_was_1.0_while_the_ank: the receipt metric was mean(sign(pros_ankle) == sign(healthy_ankle)). The healthy reference is positive on 100% of rows and the realized prosthetic ankle is positive on 100% of rows, so the comparison is DEGENERATE: it returns 1.0 by construction and carries no information. It never tested the plantarflexion requirement. The metric is hereby declared VOID for degenerate references

were_we_chasing_the_wrong_target_or_the_.verdict: the TRAINING target was the right coordinate and the right signal (prosthetic-side IK, which does contain the negative tract). The REPORTING reference was a different coordinate (healthy contralateral) and was silently used to judge quality
were_we_chasing_the_wrong_target_or_the_.consequence_measured: S0D sits at RMSE 0.04763 from the healthy ankle while the IK target sits at 0.13480 from it. Optimising towards u_IK therefore moves AWAY from the healthy reference BY CONSTRUCTION: A2 went 0.04763 -> 0.06772. The 'quality regression' of A2 is the mechanical consequence of optimising towards one reference while grading against the other, not a defect of the fit
were_we_chasing_the_wrong_target_or_the_.rule_from_now_on: quality is judged prosthetic-vs-prosthetic-IK in the prosthetic convention; the healthy contralateral signal is a SYMMETRY diagnostic and may never be used for sign agreement or as the optimisation reference

q1_why_the_offline_gain_does_not_transfe.action_space_transfer_is_GOOD: A2 closed 19% (knee) and 15% (ankle) of the action gap to u_IK on its own visited states, matching the offline holdout gain (18.3% / 13.8%)
q1_why_the_offline_gain_does_not_transfe.joint_angle_space_transfer_is_ASYMMETRIC: RMSE(pros_knee, q_knee_IK): S0D 0.12639 -> A2 0.12279 (slightly better). RMSE(pros_ankle, q_ankle_IK): S0D 0.13458 -> A2 0.15229 (WORSE). The ankle gain does not merely fail to transfer: it inverts
q1_why_the_offline_gain_does_not_transfe.mechanism: only one half of the ankle command change is physically realisable, so a symmetric change in command produces an ASYMMETRIC change in the realised joint: the positive half lands, the negative half is absorbed. The realised ankle therefore drifts upward

q2_why_the_ankle_stays_POSITIVE_evidence.the_policy_ALREADY_commands_plantarflexi: S0D commands q_ankle down to -0.49494 on 11.8% of rows - far more negative than the IK target's -0.15516. A2 commands down to -0.28817 on 11.0% of rows
q2_why_the_ankle_stays_POSITIVE_evidence.the_command_never_reaches_the_joint: pros_ankle_angle_served_ref NEVER goes negative: S0D min +0.01600 (0.0% negative), A2 min +0.03170 (0.0%). The realised joint follows the served reference almost exactly
q2_why_the_ankle_stays_POSITIVE_evidence.quantified_on_the_rows_that_matter: on the 46 S0D rows commanding q_ankle < -0.05, the served reference averages +0.1918 and the realised angle +0.1906: the command is simply not honoured
q2_why_the_ankle_stays_POSITIVE_evidence.not_an_actuator_saturation: pros_ankle_angle_sea_u stays within |u| <= 0.052 and never approaches 1.0: the SEA is not saturated. The block is in the reference-governor / slew path (ankle slew 2.0 rad/s = 0.02 rad per 10 ms step), not in the actuator
q2_why_the_ankle_stays_POSITIVE_evidence.smoking_gun: on the 97 rows where the IK target is NEGATIVE, the realised ankle went from S0D +0.1433 to A2 +0.1743: on exactly the push-off rows where plantarflexion is wanted, A2 is MORE dorsiflexed than S0D

CAUSAL_DIAGNOSIS.BLOCKER_DECLARED: a negative realised ankle excursion is NOT achievable by any policy change under the current frozen reference-governor/slew configuration. Even a command of -0.49 produces a served reference of +0.19. Preregistering an ankle-negative gate on the realised joint angle would preregister an UNREACHABLE gate. This is a plant/pipeline finding, not a learning finding, and its remedy lies in production configuration, which this stage may not touch

S1C_PROTOCOL.init: EXCLUSIVELY S0D 481dd0d22919fc1ec04cdb722409b9711caeb61d57449c210aad7386375b764a. A1..A6 and S1A are never init, source or anchor
S1C_PROTOCOL.stage_order: S1C-0 feasibility probe (offline, no fit, no rollout) -> architect review -> S1C-1 fit (only if S1C-0 says REACHABLE) -> architect review -> closed-loop gate under its own token

S1C_0_feasibility_probe.question: under the FROZEN production reference path, does there exist ANY admissible command sequence that drives the realised pros_ankle_angle to <= -0.03 inside the B3 phase window?
S1C_0_feasibility_probe.method: offline reachability on the recorded traces: forward-simulate the served-reference dynamics (6 Hz filter + 2.0 rad/s ankle slew, both frozen) from the observed states under the most aggressive admissible command, and compare the reachable envelope with the -0.03 requirement. Uses ONLY recorded data and frozen parameters; no episode is executed

outcomes.REACHABLE: S1C-1 may preregister a binding ankle-negative gate
outcomes.UNREACHABLE: the ankle-negative requirement is escalated to the architect as a PRODUCTION-CONFIGURATION question; no fit is run against an unreachable target

S1C_1_candidates_finite.fixed: anchor/task ratio r = 5 (the only ratio that survived the rev3t hierarchy), 300 epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 1e-4, seed 2026, deterministic, clock re-zeroed, logstd bit-identical, July parametric anchor 1e-5
S1C_1_candidates_finite.varied: a phase-localised weight w on the push-off rows (the rows where q_ankle_IK < 0), w in {2, 4, 8}, applied INSIDE the task role only
S1C_1_candidates_finite.rationale: the row-uniform MSE spends its bounded budget uniformly, while the plantarflexion requirement is concentrated on 19.2% of the rows. w localises the budget without touching the ratio r or any threshold
S1C_1_candidates_finite.conditional: this grid is executed ONLY if S1C-0 returns REACHABLE

PREREGISTERED_QUALITY_GATES.convention: all joint-angle gates on the PROSTHETIC coordinate, negative = plantarflexion, compared against the PROSTHETIC IK target. The healthy contralateral signal appears only as a symmetry diagnostic
PREREGISTERED_QUALITY_GATES.G1_gait_preservation: the seven rev3u FSM/safety gates, unchanged and binding

G2_non_regression_vs_S0D_on_the_IK_targe.rule: must be <= the S0D baseline per joint. A2 would FAIL this on the ankle (0.15229 > 0.13458): the gate that was missing

G3_non_regression_vs_S0D_on_the_symmetry.rule: must be <= 1.05 x the S0D baseline per joint, so no future candidate may improve on one reference while silently regressing on the other

G4_shape.pearson_r: per joint, >= the S0D value minus 0.02, computed vs the PROSTHETIC IK target
G4_shape.sign_agreement: VOID whenever the reference is sign-degenerate; when both signs are present it is computed and the degeneracy status is always recorded

G5_ankle_negative_excursion.metric: min realised pros_ankle_angle inside the B3 phase window [0.55, 0.80]
G5_ankle_negative_excursion.binding: ONLY if S1C-0 returns REACHABLE; otherwise recorded as an OPEN BLOCKER and never used to pass or fail a candidate
G5_ankle_negative_excursion.note: the B3 phase field has been identically zero on every v3 trace of this chain (S0D, R2I, S1A, A2), so the window itself is currently not evaluable; S1C-0 must also determine whether that field is usable

PREREGISTERED_QUALITY_GATES.no_walking_claim: no offline metric may declare walking; no gate may be relaxed to accommodate a candidate

S1C_PROTOCOL.sigma: UNRESOLVED and NOT operational. No S1C stage assumes 0.005 or any other value; rollouts, when authorised, use the deterministic mean
